import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
rng = random.Random(7)
n = 64
core_asns = list(range(1, n+1))
rib = []
# core: cycle of 64 links via length-4 rotations
for i in range(n):
    p = [core_asns[(i+k) % n] for k in range(4)]
    rib.append({'path': p, 'count': rng.randint(1, 1000000)})
# edge decorations: long branches that get peeled over many rounds
next_asn = n+1
edges = []
for i in range(300):
    anchor = rng.choice(core_asns)
    chain = [anchor]
    for k in range(rng.randint(5, 20)):
        chain.append(next_asn); next_asn += 1
    # each chain path: [leaf ... anchor] so the anchor-side link stays core-ish
    rib.append({'path': chain, 'count': rng.randint(1, 1000000)})
    rib.append({'path': chain[::-1], 'count': rng.randint(1, 1000000)})
    edges.append(chain)
# fill up to 2000 records with duplicated/rotated paths
while len(rib) < 2000:
    i = rng.randrange(n)
    p = [core_asns[(i+k) % n] for k in range(rng.randint(3, 20))]
    rib.append({'path': p, 'count': rng.randint(1, 1000000)})
total = sum(len(r['path']) for r in rib)
print('records', len(rib), 'total path len', total)
rib = rib[:2000]
if total > 40000:
    # trim lengths
    keep=[]; t=0
    for r in rib:
        if t+len(r['path'])>40000: break
        keep.append(r); t+=len(r['path'])
    rib=keep
    print('trimmed to', len(rib), t)
links = [(min(core_asns[i], core_asns[(i+1)%n]), max(core_asns[i], core_asns[(i+1)%n])) for i in range(n)]
order=[list(l) for l in links]
priors=[]
used=set()
allpairs=[]
for c in edges:
    for a,b in zip(c, c[1:]):
        k=(min(a,b),max(a,b))
        if k not in used and len(priors)<1000:
            used.add(k)
            priors.append({'link':[a,b],'weights':[rng.randint(0,1000000),rng.randint(0,1000000),rng.randint(0,1000000)]})
        if len(priors)>=1000: break
    if len(priors)>=1000: break
declared=[]
dv=set()
for i in range(600):
    a = rng.randrange(1, 400); b = rng.randrange(1, 400)
    if a==b or (min(a,b),max(a,b)) in dv: continue
    dv.add((min(a,b),max(a,b)))
    declared.append({'link':[a,b],'rel':rng.choice(['c2p','p2p','p2c'])})
queries=[]
for q in range(512):
    i = q % n
    p = [core_asns[(i+k) % n] for k in range(64)]
    b = rng.randint(1, 1000000)
    queries.append({'id':'q%d'%q,'path':p,'threshold':[rng.randint(0,b), b]})
doc={'version':1,'ixps':[core_asns[0], 999999],'rib':rib,'priors':priors,'declared':declared,'order':order,'queries':queries}
inp=json.dumps(doc).encode()
print('input bytes', len(inp))
t0=time.time()
pr=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','submission/main.py'],input=inp,capture_output=True)
print('secs',round(time.time()-t0,2),'rc',pr.returncode, 'stderr', pr.stderr[:300])
out=pr.stdout.decode()
print('out bytes', len(out))
d=json.loads(out)
if 'error' in d: print(d)
else:
    print('links', len(d['links']), 'queries', len(d['queries']))
    rounds = {}
    for rec in d['links']: rounds[rec['round']] = rounds.get(rec['round'],0)+1
    print('round histogram', sorted(rounds.items()))
    print('core links', sum(1 for rec in d['links'] if rec['round']==0))
    print('sample', d['links'][0], d['queries'][0])
PYEOF
